# Zan Huang

Canonical site: https://zanhuang.org/

Staff researcher at the Sripada Lab at the University of Michigan and executive director of HuronARC. Work in computational neuroscience, artificial intelligence, and music composition.

## Contact

- HuronARC: zanhuang@huronarc.com
- University of Michigan: zanh@umich.edu
- X / Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheZanHuang (@TheZanHuang)
- Artistic portfolio: https://zanh.myportfolio.com
- HuronARC address: 175 Jackson Plaza, Ann Arbor, MI 48103

## Current roles

- Executive director, HuronARC, a sovereign lab and holding company in Ann Arbor
- Staff researcher, Sripada Lab, University of Michigan (https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/sripada/), working on mechanistic interpretability and computational theories of cognition, and independent work in computation and AI
- Composer; selected work at https://zanh.myportfolio.com

## Former roles

- NeuroAI researcher, Laboratory for Integrated Brain Imaging, University of Michigan (https://libi.engin.umich.edu/), until May 2026. Work included eigenmodes and cortical surface methods with travelling waves, Neural AI, and functional segregation
- 2024 Foresight Institute Fellow in Neurotechnology (https://foresight.org/people/zan-huang/)
- Co-Founder, Myelin Neurotech, a nonprofit working on neurotechnology research

## Education

- B.S., Computational Cognitive Science, High Honors, University of Michigan
- B.M., Music Composition, High Honors, University of Michigan
- Minors in Computer Science and Complex Systems
- Sam Epstein Award for Contributions to Theoretical Cognitive Science, Weinberg Institute for Cognitive Science

## Languages

- English (native)
- Chinese (native speaking / professional fluency)
- German (functional B1–B2)

## Research interests

Alternative computational models of artificial intelligence; modeling of mass social patterns; chaotic and emergent phenomena in physical and information systems; linguistics; neurologically inspired modularity and compositional generalization in visual perception systems.

## Publications

- Hu, X., Angstadt, M., Storks, S., Huang, Z., Taxali, A., Weigard, A., Lewis, R. L., & Sripada, C. (2026). Conflict and Congruency Effects in Large Language Models: In-Weight and In-Context Competition in a Verbal Conflict Task. arXiv:2608.11510. https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11510
- Huang, Z. (2025). Emerging Functional Differentiation of Multiplicatively Combined Neural Network Pathways through Contrastive Predictive Coding and Input Segregation. Undergraduate thesis, University of Michigan.

## Artistic work

Studied with Rodney Lister at the New England Conservatory Preparatory School, and with Paul Schoenfield, Bright Sheng, and Evan Chambers at the University of Michigan.

Selected works:

- Nocturne — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=baxBlABzeWo
- After the Violinkonzert — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d89Mn8zzxCo
- Black Mass [For Good Friday] (2024), for 12-piece choir, string quartet, and piano — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9OJOVm4swSs
- In Portbou (2023), for Pierrot ensemble, electronics, mezzo, and baritone — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=75J2pbFAHmg
